messages:
sam_oncall: Alert: EU dedicated pool eu1-dedicated-12 is showing sustained 99th latency ~2.3s for generation endpoints and a throughput drop of ~30%. Customers hitting SLA alerts. I see a spike in evictions and kernel fallbacks.

elaine_rt: saw the same on dashboards, KV cache hit-rate dropped sharply on that pool (92% -> ~56%) around the same time window. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: Deployed eng-runtime r2023.4 (batching heuristics tweak + kernel selector change) at 10:07 UTC.

miguel_sre: Confirming eviction churn on hosts in that pool (hosts eu1-12a..eu1-12d). Coordinator fallthrough seems to prefer the smaller-kernel variant under pressure which doesn't share KV caches across tenants -> frequent KV invalidations.

nina_perf: Ran a quick profile for the window 10:10-10:20. We're seeing increased kernel-switch overhead and lower batch packing efficiency after r2023.4.

nina_perf: ```
kv_hit_rate: before=0.92 after=0.56
avg_batch_size: before=48 after=29
kernel_switches/s: before=0.4 after=3.7
99p_latency_ms: before=420 after=2300
```

sam_oncall: can infra quota changes be a factor? maybe hosts got overpacked so noisy tenants concentrated.

elaine_rt: digging through infra changes now — found a recent change in infra repo: rinfra#559 bumped dedicated.max_tenants_per_host from 6 -> 12 to increase density (deployed ~09:58 UTC). Affinity/placement logic didn't change.

miguel_sre: That explains it: higher tenant density + new kernel selector/batching heuristics = smaller batches, more kernel fallbacks, KV thrash, more evictions. It's the classic placement+density combo.

nina_perf: I reproduced locally with a replay of the tenant mix + r2023.4 behavior. If we throttle kernel fallbacks and force larger batch packing we reduce the 99p by ~700ms in the replay.

sam_oncall: Suggested action plan: 1) rollback runtime r2023.4 on eu1-dedicated-12 2) revert the quota density bump in infra 3) run KV warmup / eviction sweep on affected hosts 4) open formal incident doc and postmortem.

elaine_rt: rolling back runtime now on the affected hosts and starting eviction sweep script (kv-evict-sweep v1). I will also open the infra rollback PR.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: eng-runtime r2023.4 -> r2023.3 on eu1-dedicated-12 (4 hosts) — status: in progress.

ops-bot: Escalation created: INC-9982. Notifying SE and account owners for impacted customers.

nina_perf: after initial rollback on 4 hosts: 99p down to ~1100ms, KV hit-rate improving to ~78%. Still above target but trending down. Continuing replay/validation.

sam_oncall: Good progress. Keep updates here with timestamps and diffs. We'll collect profiling artifacts (perf traces + coordinator logs) for the postmortem. Owner: sam_oncall (incident lead), elaine_rt (runtime rollback + infra PR), miguel_sre (placement analysis), nina_perf (profiling + validation). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

elaine_rt: I'll post the infra rollback PR link and the host list once sweep is complete.

miguel_sre: quick note — add a temporary placement guard to limit new tenant placements to 6 per host until we have a long-term fix.

sam_oncall: Agreed. I'll push the placement guard now and update INC-9982.
